description: World Bank economic indicators as JSON, no API key: any of the 1,434 World Development Indicators (GDP, inflation, population, unemployment, CO2, life expectancy, electricity access, debt...) for 217 economies and regional aggregates, 1960 to the latest year. Modes: latest value with change, yearly Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/world-bank-indicators-api.

countries.description: ISO2 (US, DE, BG), ISO3 (USA, DEU) or English names (Germany). Aggregates work too (WLD = world, EUU = EU, HIC = high income). Up to 20. Empty = US, CN, DE, IN, BR.

fromYear.description: For history and compare: first year (1960 or later). Default 20 years ago.

includeAggregates.description: For rank and countries: also include regional/income aggregates such as World or Euro area.

incomeGroup.description: For rank: only countries of this income group, e.g. High income, Lower middle income.

indicators.description: World Bank codes (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD) or plain words (gdp, inflation, population, unemployment, gdp per capita, co2 per capita, life expectancy, electricity access). Up to 10; rank and compare use the first one. Use mode=search to find codes. E

mode.description: latest = newest value per country and indicator with the change vs the year before; history = one row per country, indicator and year; rank = countries ranked by one indicator in one year; compare = growth of one indicator between two years

order.description: For rank: desc = highest first, asc = lowest first.

query.description: For search: words to find indicators, e.g. female unemployment, renewable energy, government debt.

region.description: For rank: only countries of this World Bank region, e.g. Europe & Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa.

toYear.description: For history and compare: last year. Default the latest year.

year.description: For rank: the year to rank. Default = the latest year where at least half of the reporting countries have data.

name: world_bank_indicators_api
title: World Bank Economic Indicators API - 1,400+ Series
